name: Entry
note: cartridge entry point: nop; jp $176A

name: Boot
note: the entry jumps here

name: Call_HL
note: jp hl: a call to $0150 calls the routine at HL

name: Call_BC
note: push bc; ret: calls the routine at BC

name: Call_DE
note: push de; ret: calls the routine at DE

name: Far_Jump
note: one-way far jump: A = bank (hFF8B and $2100); jp hl

name: Far_Call
note: far call: B = bank; pushes the caller's bank; the callee returns through jp $0173

name: Far_CallKeepA
note: far call keeping A through hFF8A: B = bank; HL = target

name: Far_Return
note: pops the caller's bank; switches back; ret

name: Far_ReturnSramBank
note: return restoring a bank read from the stack (SRAM routines)

name: JumpTable_ByA
note: jump to word A of the table at HL

name: JumpTable_Inline
note: jump to word A of the table that follows the call

name: FarJumpTable_ByA
note: far call of record A of the {lo; hi; bank} table at HL through $015B

name: Mode_Set
note: mode = A (hFF8D)

name: State_Set
note: state = A (hFF8E)

name: ModeState_Set
note: mode = B; state = C

name: ModeState_SetInline
note: mode and state from the two bytes after the call

name: Copy_Inline
note: copy with inline {source; destination; count} after the call

name: Copy_DEtoHL
note: copy BC bytes from DE to HL

name: Copy_FarInline
note: copy with inline {source; bank; destination; count} after the call

name: Copy_FarDEtoHL
note: copy BC bytes from DE in bank A to HL

name: Lcd_SetupInline
note: 11 inline bytes: LCDC; BGP; OBP0; OBP1; SCY; SCX; WY; WX; -; STAT; IE

name: Lcd_SetupInlineNoIE
note: 10 inline bytes: the same without IE

name: Vram_CopyHBlank
note: copy BC bytes from DE to VRAM at HL in H-blank steps (current bank)

name: Vram_CopyHBlankFar
note: the same from bank A

name: Main_Loop
note: calls the mode routine of ModeTable through $01A0 every frame

name: Lcdc_SetCallbackNext
note: stores the LCDC-interrupt callback (DE) for the next frame (hFFA6/A7)

name: Lcdc_SetCallback
note: stores the LCDC-interrupt callback (DE) in hFFA4/A5

name: Serial_SetFarCallback
note: 3 inline bytes: a far callback {lo; hi; bank} stored in hFF97-99

name: Object_Create
note: object creation with BC = 0; falls into Object_CreateWithParam

name: Object_CreateWithParam
note: DE = descriptor in bank 2; BC = parameter; fills a 23-byte slot at $DAEE

name: Object_RunAll
note: the per-frame pass over the object slots (far-called from 00:1ACA; runs the slot routines at 00:2113 and 00:212F)

name: ScriptSlots_Clear
note: empties the 6 script slots of 20 bytes at $DC67 (the record book calls it on entry: BGB writes 01:5975/5976 at every visit)

name: ScriptSlots_Add
note: DE = {script; per-frame routine}: fills the first free slot of $DC67, script pointer at offsets 2-3

name: ScriptSlots_Run
note: runs one step of each busy slot of $DC67 (far called from banks 0 and 7)

name: RecordBook_CountHundreds
note: flowers of the first kind: the hundreds of the 4-digit BCD count in hFFEA-EB, 0-19, 20 from 2,000 on; 0 skips the kind

name: RecordBook_CountTens
note: flowers of the second kind: the tens digit of hFFEA

name: RecordBook_CountUnits
note: flowers of the third kind: the units digit of hFFEA

name: RecordBook_FlowerScript
note: slot script shared by the 5 vines: waits, then grows the hundreds, tens and units flowers one by one

name: RecordBook_GetTaken
note: hFFEA-EB = photos taken ($DAC9-DACA = SRAM $1000-$1001)

name: RecordBook_VineTaken
note: vine script of the taken counter (descriptor at 01:5732)

name: RecordBook_GetErased
note: hFFEA-EB = photos thrown away ($DACB-DACC = SRAM $1002-$1003)

name: RecordBook_VineErased
note: vine script of the thrown-away counter (descriptor at 01:574C)

name: RecordBook_GetExchangedX11
note: hFFEA-EB += 11 x photos exchanged ($DACD-DACE, BCD adds through $0CB4); BGB: 1 exchange shows 2 flowers (1 ten, 1 unit)

name: RecordBook_VineExchanged
note: vine script of the exchanged counter (descriptor at 01:5779)

name: RecordBook_GetReceivedX11
note: hFFEA-EB = 11 x (boys $DAD1 + girls $DAD2 received); BGB: 1 received shows 2 flowers

name: RecordBook_VineReceived
note: vine script of the received counter (descriptor at 01:57C1)

name: RecordBook_GetPrintedX6
note: hFFEA-EB += 6 x photos printed ($DACF-DAD0); BGB: 1 print shows 6 flowers

name: RecordBook_VinePrinted
note: vine script of the printed counter (descriptor at 01:57EE)

name: FactoryCheck_PutHexByte
note: A as two hex digit tiles at [HL+] (the digit value is the tile id); called by Mode0D_State00

name: FactoryCheck_PutHexDigit
note: one digit tile: ld [hl+],a

name: FactoryCheck_PutHexByteVram
note: 05:4408 through Vram_WriteByteSafe (screen on); called by Mode0D_State01

name: FactoryCheck_PutHexDigitVram
note: one digit tile through Vram_WriteByteSafe

name: Bank05_FrameUpdate
note: far-called at the start of bank-5 state handlers: Object_RunAll, then 00:21BE and 00:03D5

name: Text_PutCharAtCursor
note: A into the text buffer $DA67 at the cursor $D98C

name: Text_PutCharAt
note: A into the text buffer $DA67 at index C

name: Text_CursorRight
note: cursor $D98C + 1, at most $1A (27 characters)

name: Text_SmallGlyphAddr
note: DE = $4000 + 32 x A: an 8x16 glyph of bank $12

name: Text_DrawSmallLine
note: the 30 bytes at $DA67 as 8x16 glyphs of bank $12 into tiles $8100 (Vram_CopyHBlankFar)

name: Text_BigGlyphAddr
note: DE = $4000 + 64 x A: a 16x16 glyph of bank $09 (Font16x16_Bank09)

name: Text_CopyBigLine
note: the 27 characters at $DA67 as 16x16 glyphs of bank $09 into $9000, or into $C000 in mode $06 (printing); Copy_FarDEtoHL

name: Text_CopyBigLineVram
note: 05:643D through Vram_CopyHBlankFar

name: Text_LoadBigGlyphPage
note: 10 glyphs (640 B) of bank $09 from $4000 + $140 x [$D992] into tiles $8A00

name: Font16x16_Bank09
note: the 16x16 font: 245 glyphs of 64 B (four tiles in reading order), hiragana first (rendered); read by 05:6424 and 05:65E0, in mode $03 states $0A-$0B in the core runs

name: Font16x16_Bank0A
note: copy of Font16x16_Bank09 except 222 bytes at $7D44-$7F31; read in mode $05 state $06 in the core runs

name: Stamp_ArrangeGfx
note: copies the stamp tiles of $C3C0 into the work buffer $C000, [$D9DA] x [$D9DB] tiles, rows interleaved; mode $05 (stamp window) setup

name: Stamp_ArrangeMaskInverted
note: the same for the mask: $C5A0 into $C1E0, every byte complemented (cpl)

name: Stamp_MirrorIfFlagged
note: when $D9E1 bit 5 is set: mirrors the four stamp buffers $C000, $C1E0 (05:56FF), $C3C0 (05:5768) and $C5A0 (05:57D1)

name: Stamp_MirrorGfx
note: horizontal mirror of a buffer [$D9DA] tiles wide: each byte bit-reversed and swapped with its mirror position

name: Stamp_MirrorSrcGfx
note: mirror of $C3C0 called beside 05:56FF by Stamp_MirrorIfFlagged (other row size; loop not read in full)

name: Stamp_MirrorSrcMask
note: mirror of $C5A0 called beside 05:56FF by Stamp_MirrorIfFlagged (other row size; loop not read in full)

name: Stamp_BlitOnPhoto
note: Blit_BuildPatchList, the shift masks (05:5F29), Blit_MaskPass_SrcA or _SrcB by $D9E1 bit 7, 00:2BB9, Blit_ApplyPatchList; first run in mode $05 state $06 (core)

name: Stamp_SetShiftMasks
note: for the x offset B & 7: the bit masks of 05:5F86 into $D9ED (and its complement $D9EE), $D9EA = $38 + (B & 7), the masks of 05:5F8E

name: Stamp_LoadWindowMap
note: $100 bytes of map from [$D9D0] (bank $23) into the window map $9C00 (Vram_CopyHBlankFar); mode $05

name: Stamp_LoadWindowMapDefault
note: $100 bytes of map from 23:7150 into the window map $9C00; mode $05

name: NameCard_MakeIdNumber
note: when the 4 bytes $DADB-$DADE are all 0: fills them with 8 random digits (Rng_Next mod 10, + 1); first run on the name card, mode $0B state $01

name: TakePhotos_SetPlaneMasks
note: A x 5: five bytes of the $00 / $FF table 05:4802 into hFFAE-hFFB2, the masks of the plane-mapping loop that follows (05:4882, not traced); not run in the core

name: TakePhotos_LoadFrameTiles
note: the tiles of frame [$D8FD] (record 05:4D21 + 8 x index: source, bank, length) into $8800, then a cursor object by A; first run in mode $02 state $01 (camera view)

name: TakePhotos_PlaceFrameObjects
note: up to four objects (05:5F6B, 5F72, 5F79) at the positions of record 05:4E10 + 8 x [$D8FD] ($FF = none): the decorations of the frame

name: TakePhotos_SetFrameCallback
note: Serial_SetFarCallback with 05:4F3F (inline argument)

name: TakePhotos_FrameCallback
note: the callback set by 05:4F2E: Bank05_FrameUpdate, the sound requests of the keys ($D8D9), ...; mode $02 state $01

name: TakePhotos_FrameCallback2
note: another frame callback of the camera view: Bank05_FrameUpdate, then the keys ($D8D8 bit 3) and 00:1680

name: TakePhotos_FrameCallback3
note: a frame callback that stops while $D8D4 is set, then the keys and the frame index $D8FD ($08 = last)

name: Stamp_SelectCategory
note: copies the 8-byte record 05:5425 + 8 x [$D996] into $D9C6 and the 16 bytes at [$D9CA] into $D9CE

name: Stamp_LoadPageTiles
note: tiles of stamp [$D998 + $D996] (00:0C25 multiply) from bank [$D9C8] into $8A00, length [$D9D2]

name: Stamp_LoadSmallTiles
note: two blocks of $60 bytes from [$D9E2] and [$D9E4] (bank $0D) into $8600 and $8660

name: Stamp_LoadSelected
note: clears the four stamp buffers (00:01F2 x4), loads graphics and mask (05:559C, 05:55E2), Stamp_ArrangeGfx, Stamp_ArrangeMaskInverted, Stamp_MirrorIfFlagged, then copies $C000 to $8A00 and $C1E0 to $8C00

name: Stamp_LoadGfx
note: the graphics of stamp [$D998 + $D996] from bank [$D9C8], offset [$D9C6], into $C3C0 (Copy_FarDEtoHL)

name: Stamp_LoadMask
note: the mask of the same stamp into $C5A0 when $D9E0 is neither 0 nor $FF (read in part)

name: Stamp_CursorCallback
note: 05:5844 then Far_Return

name: Stamp_CursorUpdate
note: object callback: position from $D9A9-$D9AA; in step $D994 = 0 shows it (00:222C), = 2 reads the D-pad ($D8DA) to move it

name: Stamp_SetBlitArea
note: $D9F1-$D9F5 from the stamp position and size ($D9AB-$D9AE) and the buffer $C3C0, before Stamp_BlitOnPhoto

name: Cursor_Callback61FF
note: 05:61FF then Far_Return

name: Cursor_Update61FF
note: object callback like Stamp_CursorUpdate with $D991: shows it in step $D994 = 0, moves it with the D-pad in step 2

name: Text_DrawBigCharAtCursor
note: the 16x16 glyph of the character at the cursor ($DA67 + [$D98C]) into $9000 + 64 x cursor

name: Digits_LowNibbleTileAddr
note: DE = 0C:7B40 + 16 x (low nibble of $DA60[A]); $B gives 0

name: Digits_HighNibbleTileAddr
note: DE = 0C:7B40 + (high nibble of $DA60[A]) x 16; $B gives 0

name: Digits_CopyDA60
note: the 4 bytes $DA60 as 8 digit tiles of bank $0C into $8600 (into $C600 in mode $06, printing), then more at $84E0 / $C4E0

name: TakePhotos_DrawRowsLeftBg
note: four 13-tile rows from the records at [$D386] into the BG map at $9842, $9862, $9A42, $9A62 (00:0ABA), and 2 tiles at $9887; mode $02 state $08

name: TakePhotos_DrawRowsRightBg
note: the same at $984F, $986F, $9A4F, $9A6F and $988F

name: TakePhotos_DrawRowsLeftWin
note: four 7-tile rows into the window map at $9C42, $9C62, $9E42, $9E62 (00:0ABE), and 2 tiles at $9C8D

name: TakePhotos_DrawRowsRightWin
note: the same from $9C49

name: TakePhotos_StorePhoto
note: Sram_ComputeImageChecksums, 00:2A8F, a free slot by 01:4D81 with A = $FF, then 01:4D9F, 01:4DE4, 01:4C2B; first run in mode $02 state $06 (photo taken)

name: Album_SlotOp6CFF
note: 01:4D81 with A = [$D933]; if no carry, 01:4C2B (bank-1 photo slot routines not named yet)

name: Album_SlotOp6D18
note: $D933 - 1 when equal to $D932, then 01:4D81, 01:4DCC, 01:4DE4, 01:49BD; mode $03 state $0D

name: Album_StorePhoto6D60
note: 00:2A8F, a free slot by 01:4D81 with A = $FF, 01:4D9F, 01:4DE4, 01:4C2B (05:6CCD without the checksums); mode $03 state $11

name: NameCard_NameGlyphAddr
note: DE = $6000 + 32 x A: an 8x16 glyph of bank $12

name: NameCard_DrawName
note: the 9 characters at $DADF as 8x16 glyphs of bank $12 into tiles $8A00; mode $03 state $00

name: NameCard_DigitGlyphAddr
note: DE = $6E50 + 32 x A (bank $33)

name: NameCard_DrawBirthday
note: the 4 BCD bytes at $DAE9 as digit glyphs of bank $33 into $8B60 (0 drawn as glyph $0A); the birthday of the ID card (I)

name: NameCard_DrawBloodType
note: glyph ($DAE8 & 3) of 30:7FA0 into $8B20 (0 drawn as glyph 2); the blood type of the ID card (I)

name: NameCard_DrawSex
note: glyph (($DAE8 >> 2) & 7) of 1D:7F40 into $8B40 (0 drawn as glyph 4); the boy / girl field of the ID card (I)

name: TakePhotos_DrawNumber
note: A (0 taken as 1) as BCD (00:0C9A) with digit tiles of 0C:7840 into $87B0; mode $02 state $03

name: Album_LoadTilesBank0D
note: five blocks of $C0 bytes from bank $0D ($4600-$4A00) into $9380 and $84C0; mode $03 state $00

name: Album_LoadTilesBank15
note: five blocks of $C0 bytes from bank $15 ($5380-$5500, $44C0-$4580) into $9380 and $84C0; mode $03 state $03
